furnishings.name_ja: 謎解きのパートナー‐「さよなら、緊張」
furnishings.description: A doll modeled on Faruzan combined with a popular Floating Hydro Fungus toy beloved by students. It is fully equipped for autonomous operation, featuring built-in walking mechanisms, weight sensors, terrain recognition, and remote control capabilities. A collaboration between the Puzzlers' League and the Symposium on Ruin Mechanisms, this Puzzlepal is a high-tech creation that retains its adorable charm, easing frayed nerves even in dark, creepy ruins.
